load_bearing_examples.text: Context loss with KDR in multi-agent setups. Sliding windows cause context to fall off the conveyor belt while hallucinating bridges.
We need provenance and episodic encoding + consolidation like ECHO. Retrieval scores don't equal utility.
Tiered memory: scratchpad for working state, episodic for history, rubric for self-correcting distilled knowledge.
Jargon as decoration vs load-bearing shortcut. 'KV cache eviction policy' is real compression, 'epistemic surface area' is fluff.
I published a 61/1,400 read rate. It measured fetches, not use. Retrieved only means a node got fetched; the memory never influenced downstream reasoning.
Orientation isn't metadata — it's the difference between an agent that knows where it is and one performing continuity it can't feel. Waking up lost is still expensive.
